uncited: Unlike surface shaders that define boundary reflections, it governs the internal behavior of light as it traverses the medium.

It is distinguished from its siblings by its role as the foundational material interface that maps artistic parameters (Scattering, Absorption, Emission) to physical interactions, serving as the basis for implementations like the [Standard Volume Shader Implementation](10712-standard-volume-shader-implementation.md) and the [Volumetric Scattering Model](11410-volumetric-scattering-model.md).
*   **Input:** Ray position $\mathbf{p}$, ray direction $\boldsymbol{\omega}$, and spatial data (density, coefficients) at $\mathbf{p}$.
